title: FarmingOutlook (F2 farmland, F3 crops, F4 decisions)
description: v0.4, reviewed by lane A. Served by GET /api/farming?country=EGY from ml/outputs/farming_<ISO>.json. Written today by python ml/farming.py (FAO ECOCROP calculator); a trained model replaces it by writing the same file. Check a file with: python run.py farming-check. Flat arrays use index k = i * ncols + j, row i from the south, column j from the west, and have nrows * ncols values. Only the fields under 'required' are needed: the app shows every other field when it is present and hides that part when it is not.

score_grid.description: One value per cell: integer 0 to 100 (100 = ideal), null outside the country.

number_grid.description: One value per cell, null where there is none.

per_crop_scores.description: crop id -> one score_grid per horizon, in the order of 'horizons'.

per_mode_per_crop.description: mode (irrigated, rainfed) -> crop id -> one grid.

method.description: One or two sentences describing the model, shown in the app under 'How we know'.

source.description: Optional. Short name of the data behind the scores, shown as 'Source: ...', e.g. 'NASA POWER climate and FAO ECOCROP crop needs'.

score_note.description: Optional. How to read a score, in plain words, shown under 'How we know' in the place panel.

climate_period.description: Optional. The years temp_now_c is averaged over, e.g. '2016 to 2025'.

horizons.description: The years the scores are given for, first = now. The app makes one button per year, e.g. [2025, 2030, 2035]. One year is enough.

inside.description: One character per cell: 1 = the cell touches the country.

evidence.description: Optional. One character per cell: strength of the warming trend (S strong, M moderate, N not proven, - no data).

suitable_threshold.description: Optional (default 50). Score at which a crop 'fits' a place.

suitability.description: At least one water mode. A mode that is missing has its button switched off in the app.

years_to_heat_limit.description: Optional. crop id -> grid of years until the crop gets too hot (99 = safe, null = not applicable). Without it the 'Years to heat limit' view is hidden.

suitability_10_low.description: Optional: last horizon, low end of the uncertainty.

suitability_10_high.description: Optional: last horizon, high end of the uncertainty.

best_start_month.description: Optional: 0 = January, start of the best season now.
